1: // Simple Canvas Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the host HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Player (dot)
12:   const player = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     r: 5,
16:     speed: 3,
17:     dx: 0,
18:     dy: 0,
19:     update() {
20:       this.x = Math.max(this.r, Math.min(width - this.r, this.x + this.dx));
21:       this.y = Math.max(this.r, Math.min(height - this.r, this.y + this.dy));
22:     },
23:     draw() {
24:       ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
25:       ctx.beginPath();
26:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
27:       ctx.fill();
28:     }
29:   };
30: 
31:   // Simple moving walls – each wall is a rectangle that slides and shrinks the gap.
32:   const walls = [];
33:   const wallThickness = 20;
34:   let gapSize = 200; // initial gap size in the middle
35:   const gapShrinkRate = 0.2; // pixels per frame
36: 
37:   function initWalls() {
38:     // four walls creating a shrinking square gap in the centre
39:     walls.length = 0;
40:     walls.push({ // top wall
41:       x: 0,
42:       y: 0,
43:       w: width,
44:       h: wallThickness,
45:       dx: 0,
46:       dy: 0
47:     }, { // bottom wall
48:       x: 0,
49:       y: height - wallThickness,
50:       w: width,
51:       h: wallThickness,
52:       dx: 0,
53:       dy: 0
54:     }, { // left wall
55:       x: 0,
56:       y: 0,
57:       w: wallThickness,
58:       h: height,
59:       dx: 0,
60:       dy: 0
61:     }, { // right wall
62:       x: width - wallThickness,
63:       y: 0,
64:       w: wallThickness,
65:       h: height,
66:       dx: 0,
67:       dy: 0
68:     });
69:   }
70: 
71:   function updateWalls() {
72:     // shrink the central gap uniformly
73:     gapSize = Math.max(30, gapSize - gapShrinkRate);
74:     const gx = (width - gapSize) / 2;
75:     const gy = (height - gapSize) / 2;
76:     // top wall
77:     walls[0].w = width;
78:     walls[0].h = wallThickness;
79:     walls[0].x = 0;
80:     walls[0].y = 0;
81:     // bottom wall
82:     walls[1].w = width;
83:     walls[1].h = wallThickness;
84:     walls[1].x = 0;
85:     walls[1].y = height - wallThickness;
86:     // left wall
87:     walls[2].x = 0;
88:     walls[2].y = 0;
89:     walls[2].w = wallThickness;
90:     walls[2].h = height;
91:     // right wall
92:     walls[3].x = width - wallThickness;
93:     walls[3].y = 0;
94:     walls[3].w = wallThickness;
95:     walls[3].h = height;
96:     // carve the gap by overlaying a clear rectangle (the player can pass)
97:     // Not needed for collision – we simply keep walls static and rely on gapSize for win condition.
98:   }
99: 
100:   function drawWalls() {
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444444';
102:     walls.forEach(w => {
103:       ctx.fillRect(w.x, w.y, w.w, w.h);
104:     });
105:   }
106: 
107:   function collidesWithWalls() {
108:     // Simple AABB collision for each wall
109:     for (const w of walls) {
110:       if (player.x + player.r > w.x && player.x - player.r < w.x + w.w &&
111:           player.y + player.r > w.y && player.y - player.r < w.y + w.h) {
112:         // But allow the central gap area
113:         const gapLeft = (width - gapSize) / 2;
114:         const gapTop = (height - gapSize) / 2;
115:         if (!(player.x > gapLeft && player.x < gapLeft + gapSize &&
116:               player.y > gapTop && player.y < gapTop + gapSize)) {
117:           return true;
118:         }
119:       }
120:     }
121:     return false;
122:   }
123: 
124:   let score = 0;
125:   let gameOver = false;
126:   let lastTime = performance.now();
127: 
128:   function loop(timestamp) {
129:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
130:     lastTime = timestamp;
131:     if (gameOver) {
132:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
133:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
134:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
135:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
136:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
137:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
138:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
139:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
140:       return;
141:     }
142: 
143:     // update
144:     player.update();
145:     updateWalls();
146:     score += delta / 1000;
147: 
148:     // check collision
149:     if (collidesWithWalls()) {
150:       gameOver = true;
151:     }
152: 
153:     // render
154:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
155:     drawWalls();
156:     // draw gap (optional visual aid)
157:     ctx.clearRect((width - gapSize) / 2, (height - gapSize) / 2, gapSize, gapSize);
158:     player.draw();
159: 
160:     // score display
161:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
162:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
163:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
164:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
165: 
166:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167:   }
168: 
169:   // Input handling
170:   const keys = {};
171:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
172:     keys[e.key] = true;
173:     updateDirection();
174:   });
175:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
176:     keys[e.key] = false;
177:     updateDirection();
178:   });
179: 
180:   function updateDirection() {
181:     player.dx = 0; player.dy = 0;
182:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) player.dy = -player.speed;
183:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) player.dy = player.speed;
184:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A']) player.dx = -player.speed;
185:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D']) player.dx = player.speed;
186:   }
187: 
188:   // initialise and start
189:   initWalls();
190:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
191: })();
